classifications.label: Published standard
classifications.definition: A requirement defined by a standards body or an established web protocol.

classifications.label: Community convention
classifications.definition: An interoperable ecosystem convention without a governing web standard.

classifications.label: CopilotKit convention
classifications.definition: A versioned CopilotKit-specific guarantee for public machine consumers.

compatibility.updateCadence: Review quarterly and in the same pull request as any public surface change.
compatibility.additiveChanges: Fields and surfaces may be added within v1; consumers must ignore unknown fields.
compatibility.breakingChanges: Breaking schema or semantic changes require a new versioned endpoint. The previous endpoint remains available until owners publish migration guidance and communicate retirement.
compatibility.responseTypes: A versioned endpoint must not silently change its declared media type or begin returning an HTML fallback.

responseSemantics.htmlFallbacks: An HTML fallback body is invalid for a machine endpoint unless text/html is one of that endpoint's declared content types.

owners.name: CopilotKit docs maintainers
owners.cadence: Same PR as a docs surface change; quarterly contract review.

owners.name: CopilotKit website maintainers
owners.cadence: Same PR as a website surface change; quarterly contract review.

owners.name: Docs MCP service maintainers
owners.cadence: Same deployment as an MCP discovery or transport change; quarterly contract review.

surfaces.guarantee: Indexable pages emit canonical URLs on the canonical docs host.
Website-owned discovery surfaces use the canonical website host and their declared media types.

enforcement.followUp: In CopilotKit/website, test robots, sitemap, and canonical output against https://www.copilotkit.ai.

surfaces.guarantee: Advertised indexes return plain text; an HTML not-found body with status 200 is invalid.

enforcement.followUp: Fix and test the production soft-404 behavior in CopilotKit/website.

surfaces.guarantee: The currently published SSE transport does not return an HTML fallback.

enforcement.followUp: Define a separate machine-readable discovery surface in the Pathfinder-owned deployment; this repository does not own that service.

reviewChecklist: Classify each changed surface as a standard, community convention, or CopilotKit convention.
Confirm canonical host, stable path, success and error status, and Content-Type.
Update this contract in the same pull request when a surface or guarantee changes.
Add or update a fail-loud automated check for repository-owned requirements.
Name the external owner and concrete follow-up for requirements outside this repository.
Verify deployed output after release; HTML fallback pages must not pass machine-surface checks.
For breaking changes, publish a new versioned endpoint and migration guidance before retirement.
